summary: Retry block validation when local USDB indexer state is temporarily unavailable
details: Preserve structured local dependency errors through header validation and reward finalization; temporary RPC or height-readiness failures no longer become BAD BLOCK records or invalid-chain peer penalties.
Bound gossip waiting by block count, encoded bytes, peer quotas, distance, age and import concurrency; retry normal validation with backoff and preserve parent ordering.

Retry full-block and light/snap header imports within a bounded sync session, honor cancellation, and defer subsequent sessions without reconnecting peers. Permanent local retention/configuration errors stop automatic sync until repair and restart.
Require the new recovery, invalid-block, resource-limit and shutdown cases in Fast CI, and pin USDB committed-prefix query support.
operator_actions: Observe waiting, resumed and expired validation messages. Repair permanent local indexer configuration or history faults before restarting; retries do not replace deep-reorg recovery.
